provenance.tokens-only-note: packages/core/src/accordion/{Accordion,AccordionGroup,AccordionHeader,AccordionPanel}.tsx+.css are ALL real, live, fully-inspectable Salt components — every cell below is [S] unless individually marked [R]. See ACCORDION-MATRIX.md §0.
provenance.trigger-fg / trigger-fg-disabled: AccordionHeader.css color: var(--salt-content-primary-foreground) -> black/white (rest); :disabled { color: var(--salt-content-primary-foreground-disabled) } -> palette-foreground-primary-disabled -> foundations/alpha.css black-40a/white-40a = rgba(...,0.4) — the IDENTICAL -Na chain dropdown-menu.salt.json's own item-fg-disabled already resolved (Salt recolours disabled text rather than dimming opacity, hence style.trigger.opacity@disabled is off for this column — see style.trigger.color's own disabled treatment).
provenance.border-color: Accordion.css border-top: var(--salt-size-fixed-100) solid var(--salt-separable-tertiary-borderColor); AccordionGroup.css border-bottom: (same). next/characteristics/separable.css --salt-separable-tertiary-borderColor: var(--salt-palette-alpha-contrast-mediumLow) -> next/palette/alpha.css --salt-palette-alpha-contrast-mediumLow: var(--salt-color-black-20a)/var(--salt-color-white-20a) -> foundations/alpha.css black-20a: rgba(0,0,0,0.2), white-20a: rgba(255,255,255,0.2).
provenance.focus-outline: AccordionHeader.css :focus-visible { outline: var(--salt-focused-outline); outline-offset: calc(-1 * var(--salt-focused-outlineWidth)) } -> next/characteristics/focused.css --salt-focused-outline: 2px dotted var(--salt-focused-outlineColor), --salt-focused-outlineColor: var(--salt-palette-accent-stronger) -> next/palette/accent.css --salt-color-blue-700-rgb: 0,69,126 (light) / --salt-color-blue-300-rgb: 154,189,245 (dark) — the IDENTICAL accent-stronger resolution checkbox.salt.json's own focus-outline entry already made. outline-offset: -2px (inset), a size-fixed-200=2px width negated.
provenance.tone-* / bg-*: AccordionHeader.css .saltAccordionHeader-{status} { background: var(--salt-status-{status}-background) }, :focus-visible { outline-color: var(--salt-status-{status}-borderColor) }; Accordion.css .saltAccordion-{status} { border-top-color: var(--salt-status-{status}-borderColor) }; StatusIndicator.css --statusIndicator-{status}-color: var(--salt-status-{status}-foreground-decorative). next/characteristics/status.css resolves borderColor/foreground-decorative to the SAME palette-{role} 500-stop (mode-invariant) and background to the palette-{role}-weakest stop (light: 100-stop, dark: 900-stop) — the IDENTICAL tone-*/bg-*-secondary slot family alert.salt.json already resolved: tone-error rgb(229,33,53), tone-warning rgb(199,83,0), tone-success rgb(0,135,93); bg-error rgb(255,236,234)/rgb(69,0,2), bg-warning rgb(255,236,217)/rgb(66,32,0), bg-success rgb(234,245,242)/rgb(0,41,21). Note: unlike Banner/alert, Accordion's own ValidationStatus has NO 'info' member — only error/warning/success (Accordion.tsx's own `status?: "error" | "warning" | "success"` prop type).
provenance.byDensity.trigger-padding / -gap / -min-: AccordionHeader.css padding: spacing-50 spacing-100; gap: spacing-100; min-height: calc(size-base + spacing-100) — ALL by density, the min-height formula IDENTICAL to dropdown-menu.salt.json's own item-min-height.
provenance.byDensity.content-padding: AccordionPanel.css .saltAccordionPanel-content: padding-left/-right: spacing-100; padding-top: spacing-100; padding-bottom: spacing-150 — expressed as the 3-value shorthand 'top horizontal bottom'.
provenance.byDensity.content-indent: AccordionPanel.css .saltAccordionPanel-indentedContent: padding-left: calc(spacing-200 + size-icon), applied ONLY when indicatorSide='left' (the default) — additive on top of content-padding's own base left padding, so the true left inset is content-padding's left value REPLACED by this larger one (the CSS rule's own specificity/order wins, matching the real .saltAccordionPanel-indentedContent selector overriding .saltAccordionPanel-content's own padding-left in the cascade).
provenance.byDensity.icon-height: AccordionHeader.css .saltAccordionHeader-icon / .saltAccordionHeader-statusIndicator: height: size-base (width unset, intrinsic/auto) — the icon and the status indicator share the SAME height formula.
provenance.byDensity.type-trigger: characteristics/text.css body role fontSize/lineHeight/fontFamily (Open Sans, IDENTICAL sizes to dropdown-menu.salt.json's own type-body), but AccordionHeader.css's own font-weight: var(--salt-text-fontWeight-strong) -> foundations/typography.css --salt-typography-fontWeight-semiBold: 600 — A DIFFERENT, BOLDER weight stop from the plain body-regular (400) text every other Salt column's item/trigger text has used so far.

structure.group.source: AccordionGroup, a real but purely presentational wrapper (AccordionGroup.tsx/.css)

structure.item.source: Accordion — this IS the single collapsible unit (Accordion.tsx)

structure.header.note: CONFIRMED ABSENT — AccordionHeader.tsx renders the <button> directly, no wrapping heading element of any kind

structure.status-icon.source: StatusIndicator, rendered in AccordionHeader when status is set and not disabled

behavior.expand-toggle.source: AccordionHeader.tsx handleClick -> toggle(), native button gives Enter/Space for free

behavior.exclusive-expand.note: CONFIRMED ABSENT — AccordionGroup.tsx holds no state/context; each Accordion's `expanded` boolean is entirely independent (useControlled scoped per instance)

behavior.collapsible-to-none.note: MOOT, not missing — with no exclusive-expand mechanism, every individual Accordion already toggles freely to either state regardless of siblings

behavior.arrow-navigation.note: CONFIRMED ABSENT — grepped directly, no keydown handler of any kind beyond the native button's own Enter/Space anywhere in packages/core/src/accordion/

behavior.home-end.note: CONFIRMED ABSENT, same reason as behavior.arrow-navigation — no roving-focus code exists to jump within

behavior.disabled-item.source: AccordionHeader.tsx passes disabled={disabled} straight to the native <button>

prop.type.note: no group-level type concept exists — see behavior.exclusive-expand

style.trigger.shape.note: CONFIRMED OFF — AccordionHeader.css has no border-radius rule of its own

style.trigger.text-decoration@hover.note: CONFIRMED OFF — AccordionHeader.css has no :hover rule of any kind, only :focus-visible and :disabled

style.trigger.outline@focus-visible.source: AccordionHeader.css :focus-visible { outline: var(--salt-focused-outline); outline-offset: calc(-1 * var(--salt-focused-outlineWidth)) }

style.trigger.opacity@disabled.note: Salt recolours (content-primary-foreground-disabled, see style.trigger.color) rather than reducing opacity — the same 'recolour not opacity' pattern dropdown-menu.salt.json's own item column already established

style.icon.color.note: CONFIRMED OFF — no dedicated icon-colour rule anywhere in AccordionHeader.css, inherits the trigger's own text colour

style.icon.transform@expanded.note: CONFIRMED OFF — Salt does not rotate anything; it SWAPS the glyph itself (ChevronDown -> ChevronUp)

style.icon.transition.note: CONFIRMED OFF — no icon-specific transition rule, the glyph swap is instantaneous

style.content.padding@indented.source: .saltAccordionPanel-indentedContent { padding-left: calc(spacing-200 + size-icon) }, applied when indicatorSide="left"

style.content.font-size.note: CONFIRMED OFF — AccordionPanel.css sets no font property, content is arbitrary consumer markup

style.content.expand-transition.value: grid-template-rows 300ms ease-in-out, opacity 300ms ease-in-out, visibility 300ms ease-in-out
style.content.expand-transition.source: AccordionPanel.css transition: grid-template-rows var(--salt-duration-perceptible) ease-in-out, opacity ..., visibility ... (--salt-duration-perceptible: 300ms)
